name: Ruijie-Harness
releaseNotes: Packages: Windows x64 Setup EXE; macOS Universal DMG only (Apple Silicon + Intel); Linux x64 AppImage and deb.

v2.1.8 repairs DeepSeek streaming: invalid saved GPTAuth website endpoints are removed, completed streams without only [DONE] remain compatible, and genuinely truncated streams retry with a bounded policy.
When OpenMausBot starts Harness headlessly, a normal user launch now mounts and shows the desktop window instead of leaving the existing headless instance hidden.
A version bump pushed to main automatically starts this three-platform candidate workflow and creates the corresponding GitHub prerelease after all platform and native-Intel checks pass.
Candidate only: real SSO/model/IM, upgrade, and physical macOS TCC acceptance remain required.
The repository's v2.1.7 tag is used as the available automated comparison point; it is not claimed to have passed human acceptance.
Linux is a new experimental packaging target. Its installed runtime and desktop integration require validation.
GitHub Release does not update the existing gptauth.ruijie.com.cn application update service.
